Task: Locate the anchor function for the rewrite_token field in the console.log object whose action is route.rewrite after typing the route path, choosing the view policy, enabling preserve-scroll, and clicking Commit Route on the page. The same rewrite_token value is also written into the X-Route-Key header of a fetch request to the view prefetch endpoint and into the pushed route URL issued on commit. Return exactly one complete function as a single JSON object (see answer_format).
